step1_analysis.description: This circuit consists of an NMOS input transistor and a diode-connected PMOS load. It functions as a low-gain inverting amplifier or a bias voltage generator that converts an input common-mode voltage (V_CM) into a PMOS bias voltage (V_B).

DC_Output_Voltage.description: DC voltage at the output node V_B for a given input V_CM (e.g., 0.6V).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square-law model for SKY130 parameters at VDD=1.8V.

DC_Current.description: DC current drawn from the supply at V_CM = 0.6V.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on NMOS saturation current at V_CM = 0.6V.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_n = 2*Id/Vov_n = 486uS. gm_p = 2*Id/Vov_p = 209uS. Gain = gm_n / gm_p = 2.32 V/V = 7.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ratio of NMOS transconductance to PMOS diode-connected transconductance.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, AC small-signal gain, and DC transfer characteristics of the bias circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Bias Circuit
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 V_B V_CM GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 V_B V_B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCM V_CM 0 dc 0.6 ac 1

.control
  * Operating Point Analysis
  op
  let v_out_dc = v(V_B)
  let i_dd = -i(VVDD)
  let p_dc = i_dd * 1.8
  print v_out_dc i_dd p_dc

  * AC Analysis for Small-Signal Gain
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(V_B)
  meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=100

  * DC Sweep for Transfer Characteristic
  dc VCM 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc v_b_at_0v6 find v(V_B) at=0.6
  meas dc gain_at_0v6 deriv v(V_B) at=0.6
  
  quit
.endc
.end
